evidence.detail: td.contains-mana-bar has fixed width: 3rem with no responsive override at 640px breakpoint where other table cells shrink
At max-width 640px, main th/td get max-width: 7em and tighter padding, but the mana bar cell and bar itself have no matching adjustment
Author stated 'in my recent alterations to mana-bar and table spacing I didn't spend too long on non-Desktop view' — exact visual defect unspecified, requires running site to diagnose

triage.notes: The open-ended 'figure out' title and absence of a specified defect means someone needs to visually audit the site at 640px and below before writing CSS. The fix will likely be a narrow-view media query for td.contains-mana-bar and .mana-bar in pd.css.
